carbon isotopes in whole-rock samples from limestone sequences can be used to document changes in the global isotopic composition of carbon, and to identify the timing of these changes.

the isotopic record of extinction events is complex, and that the most promising approach to unravelling it is to focus on the isotope compositions of the skeletal constituents.
